The federal court will most likely grant the motion to remand. Under 28 U.S.C. §1441(a), only a defendant can remove a case, so a plaintiff who chose state court has no removal right, even though the federal claims would have supported original federal-question jurisdiction. The team note saying either party can remove is incorrect. The thirty-day deadline in §1446 applies only to defendants, and the plaintiff's removal is a procedural defect that the employer timely raised.

CONFIDENCE: 95
